meta.name: Aspirants 2021
meta.description:
Aspirants is a story of 3 friends - Abhilash, SK, and Guri. The story takes place in the past and the present where the past captures the struggle and the drama behind the making of UPSC CSE aspirants in Old Rajinder Nagar of Delhi, while the present talks about the aftermath. It is the story of three UPSC aspirants journey.

Rated U/A 13+ · Returning Series · First aired 7 Apr 2021 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: The Viral Fever · Network: YouTube, Prime Video

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5 | S2 5/5 | S3 5/5

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: UPSC - Optional Me Kya Hai?
videos.overview: Abhilash has stepped into the world of Old Rajinder Nagar to prepare for the UPSC exams. His choices become difficult as it is his last attempt and he is considering changing the optional subject.( Similar to our new upcoming series Half CA). Starring Sunny Hinduja ( popularly known as Sandeep bhaiya)

videos.title: Teacher Sahi Hona Chahiye
videos.overview: Abhilash is worried about his General Studies Exam. Dissatisfied with his mentor, he decides to quit his coaching institute.

videos.title: Positive Approach Rakh Yaar
videos.overview: Taunted for his 'negative approach', Abhilash switches to studying at the library. Things turn 'positive' when Dhairya enters his life.

videos.title: Plan B Kya Hai?
videos.overview: Abhilash realizes that no matter how determined he is, it's really tough to crack UPSC and he can't be overly optimistic with his dream of becoming an IAS officer. He realizes that he needs a Plan B.

videos.title: Pre... Mains Aur Life
videos.overview: IAS Abhilash Sharma is struggling when the past meets the present. Things take a turn when a mentor from the past, returns as a friend. Continue Watching Aspirants Season 2 on PV

videos.title: Self Study
videos.overview: Abhilash shares his ambitious vision for Rampur, but businessman Dayanidhi Joshi challenges his administration, while SK and Guri are surprised by Abhilash's unexpected return to ORN in the past.

videos.title: Strategy
videos.overview: Sandeep Bhaiya's measures against a factory owner present the first roadblock in DM Abhilash's vision. Guri and SK debate whether or not to ask any favour from Abhilash for a crucial project.

videos.title: Murphy's Law
videos.overview: Abhilash confronts the striking employees, to which Sandeep registers his objection. Meanwhile, young Abhilash goes through the challenges of the MAINS exam and a painful fight with his old friend SK.

videos.title: Mock Interview
videos.overview: DM Abhilash's action against Sandeep threatens to derail their friendship with SK siding with Sandeep. Guri wins back the tender after an anonymous letter disqualifies the previous bidder.

videos.title: Final Interview
videos.overview: Dhairya confronts Abhilash and convinces him to bury the past ghosts and move on in life. Meanwhile, an angry Sandeep conspires to bring down DM Abhilash.

videos.title: Waapsi
videos.overview: Young Abhilash is ready to pursue IRS but his mentor Radha Rajesh questions his decision. DM Abhilash is facing inquiry based on ALC Sandeep Ohlans's allegations. On the personal front he tries to mend his way with SK but is rather left disheartened. A revelation from Dhairya leaves Abhilash even more worried about the inquiry.

videos.title: Santulan
videos.overview: Abhilash starts preparing for his final attempt at IAS from Mukherjee Nagar and realises the lack of right emotional balance in his preparation and life. DM Abhilash finds himself in a catch-22 situation as his old foe, from Mukherjee Nagar, Pawan returns as DM Sambhal to compete for the Education Town project. At home Abhilash and Deepa's parents are in no mood to wait for their wedding.

videos.title: Manovaigyanik Baadhayein
videos.overview: Both Abhilash and Pawan in their own capacity help the Hindi-medium aspirants in Mukherjee Nagar with English, syllabus and strategy which in turn furthers the rivalry between the two. DM Abhilash faces a setback in the process of acquiring the land for the Education Town project while DM Pawan takes the lead as the contender for the project.

videos.title: The Cut Off
videos.overview: Aspirants in Mukherjee Nagar contemplate over the possible cut off for the prelims exam. IPS Deepa Nabam is hospitalized following a police encounter. Supported by his friends SK, Guri & Dhairya, DM Abhilash takes care of Deepa while navigating through professional challenges. ALC Sandeep Ohlan tries to strike a deal with Abhilash in order to get the Education Town project for Pawan.

videos.title: De Mauka Zindagi
videos.overview: The rivalry between young Abhilash & Pawan reaches its boiling point on the last day of the mains exam. In the present, DM Abhilash decides against giving up the Education Town project in Rampur resulting in DM Pawan expressing his concerns about the system unabashedly. Abhilash further takes drastic measures.
